ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge access portal where patients delegate medical record analysis to local AI agents without exposing underlying raw health data.
ideas.title: ZK-Gated AI Agent Health Vault
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines two heavy-hitting domains from the hackathon tracks (Healthcare and Web3/Blockchain) while mirroring the ZK and AI agent architecture of the Synthesis Hackathon winner.

ideas.pitch: An immutable student credential and course completion verification protocol leveraging Solana for instant, fee-less issuance of academic badges.
ideas.title: Solana-Based Micro-Credential EdTech Ledger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the EdTech track with a Web3 backbone, following the rapid-deployment blueprint of the Superteam Turkey Solana Hackathon winner.

ideas.pitch: A localized decentralized ledger allowing private cross-border financial transactions using optimistic ZK rollups inside a Cartesi execution environment.
ideas.title: Cartesi-Powered ZK FinTech RollApp
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles the FinTech and Web3 tracks simultaneously by demonstrating genuinely hard engineering through a lightweight Layer 2 rollapp architecture.

ideas.pitch: A verification pipeline that proves news article authenticity against cryptographically signed feeds without leaking the identity of the whistleblowers.
ideas.title: Zero-Knowledge Misinformation Fact-Fortress
ideas.why_it_could_win: Meets the Cybersecurity track requirements with advanced zero-knowledge proof frameworks modeled after the UC Berkeley ZKP Hackathon winner.

ideas.pitch: An educational platform where students pay decentralized AI tutors using stealth addresses to protect their learning pattern history from public ledger surveillance.
ideas.title: Stealth-Address AI Tutor Billing
ideas.why_it_could_win: Blends EdTech and Web3 with advanced privacy features, applying the sub0 hackathon winning pattern of shielded financial activity.
